title: Whole-Body Dexterity
abstract: arXiv:2610.22184v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current humanoid dexterous manipulation remains largely confined to end-effectors and simple grasps, falling short of humans' ability to engage the entire body by bracing and sliding bulky objects against the arms and torso. We introduce Whole-Body Dexterity (WBD), a general framework that uses the robot's body and appendages as contact surfaces to grasp and manipulate objects. Our sim-to-real pipeline first generates a dataset of feasible whole-body grasps, then trains reinforcement-learning experts on a general any-to-any repositioning objective by sampling initial and goal grasps from the dataset, and distills these experts into a single policy that uses proprioception and object geometry. We show that the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Unitree G1, where it repositions a basketball and a cardboard box to regions around the torso and completes a long-horizon task that stows a box under one arm, carries it from a shelf

translated_abstract: 当前人形机器人的灵巧操作仍主要局限于末端执行器和简单的抓取动作，远不及人类能够调动整个身体、将笨重物体靠着手臂和躯干进行支撑和滑动的能力。我们提出了全身灵巧操作，这是一个利用机器人身体和四肢作为接触面来抓取和操作物体的通用框架。我们的仿真到现实流程首先生成一个可行的全身抓取数据集，然后通过从数据集中采样初始和目标抓取姿态，在通用的“任意到任意”重定位目标上训练强化学习专家策略，并将这些专家策略蒸馏为一个利用本体感觉和物体几何信息的单一策略。我们证明了该蒸馏策略可以零样本迁移到真实的宇树 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，成功将篮球和纸箱重定位到躯干周围的区域，并完成一项长时程任务——将箱子夹在一侧手臂下并从货架上搬运它。
tldr: 该论文提出全身灵巧操作（WBD）框架，让机器人利用身体和四肢作为接触面来抓取和搬运大体积物体，其蒸馏策略可零样本迁移到真实的宇树G1人形机器人上并完成长时程搬运任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Whole-Body Dexterity (WBD), a framework enabling humanoid robots to grasp and manipulate bulky objects using their bodies and limbs as contact surfaces, with a distilled policy that zero-shot transfers to a real Unitree G1 to complete long-horizon carrying tasks.
